# ============================================================ # Safety Framework Dashboard v2 # R Shiny + Leaflet + Plotly # Reads the files in ../data/web (built by the pipeline in ../R, # see ../TECHNICAL_DOCUMENTATION.md); the web build fetches the # same files from the site's data/ folder. # ============================================================ library(shiny) library(shinydashboard) library(leaflet) library(leaflet.extras) library(plotly) library(dplyr) library(readr) library(sf) # Kompatibilitäts-Helper (für ältere R-Versionen + shinylive) `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a # Number formatting — ENGLISH locale (comma thousands, point decimal), # consistent with the English UI. Vectorised for plotly formulas. de_num <- function(x, digits = 0) { out <- format(round(x, digits), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".", nsmall = digits, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) out[is.na(x)] <- "–" out } de_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) { out <- paste0(de_num(x, digits), " %") out[is.na(x)] <- "–" out } # Einheit-Helper: AccRate immer als /100 Mio km/mi (international üblich) KM_PER_MILE <- 1.609344 disp_rate <- function(rate_per_mio_km, unit = "km", digits = 3) { factor <- if (unit == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100 unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " /100 Mio mi" else " /100 Mio km" out <- paste0(de_num(rate_per_mio_km * factor, digits), unit_str) out[is.na(rate_per_mio_km)] <- "–" out } disp_rate_val <- function(rate_per_mio_km, unit = "km", digits = 3) { factor <- if (unit == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100 out <- de_num(rate_per_mio_km * factor, digits) out[is.na(rate_per_mio_km)] <- "–" out } disp_vtm <- function(vtm_mio_km, unit = "km") { factor <- if (unit == "mi") 1 / KM_PER_MILE else 1 unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " Mio mi" else " Mio km" out <- paste0(de_num(vtm_mio_km * factor, 0), unit_str) out[is.na(vtm_mio_km)] <- "–" out } disp_dist <- function(km, unit = "km") { factor <- if (unit == "mi") 1 / KM_PER_MILE else 1 unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " mi" else " km" out <- paste0(de_num(km * factor, 0), unit_str) out[is.na(km)] <- "–" out } unit_label_rate <- function(unit = "km") { if (unit == "mi") "/100 Mio mi" else "/100 Mio km" } # ── Bundesländer (Lat/Lng-Zentren + Bbox für Map-Sprung) ───────────────────── BUNDESLAENDER <- tibble::tribble( ~ULAND, ~name, ~lat, ~lng, ~zoom, 1L, "Schleswig-Holstein", 54.20, 9.70, 8, 2L, "Hamburg", 53.55, 10.00, 10, 3L, "Niedersachsen", 52.80, 9.20, 7, 4L, "Bremen", 53.10, 8.80, 10, 5L, "Nordrhein-Westfalen", 51.45, 7.55, 8, 6L, "Hessen", 50.65, 9.00, 8, 7L, "Rheinland-Pfalz", 49.95, 7.30, 8, 8L, "Baden-Württemberg", 48.60, 9.05, 7, 9L, "Bayern", 49.00, 11.50, 7, 10L, "Saarland", 49.40, 7.00, 9, 11L, "Berlin", 52.52, 13.40, 10, 12L, "Brandenburg", 52.40, 13.05, 8, 13L, "Mecklenburg-Vorpommern", 53.80, 12.50, 8, 14L, "Sachsen", 51.05, 13.45, 8, 15L, "Sachsen-Anhalt", 51.95, 11.70, 8, 16L, "Thüringen", 50.90, 11.00, 8 ) # ── Data location ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # The app reads the files built by the pipeline step R/07_web.R: locally from # ../data/web on the desktop, over HTTP from data/ next to the deployed app in # the browser (shinylive / WebAssembly). One data model for both. IS_WASM <- identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Emscripten") if (IS_WASM) { BASE <- "data" dir.create(BASE, showWarnings = FALSE) } else { BASE <- if (dir.exists("../data/web")) normalizePath("../data/web") else "data" } # Resolve a data file: local path on the desktop; fetch-and-cache in the browser. data_path <- function(fname) { fp <- file.path(BASE, fname) if (!IS_WASM || file.exists(fp)) return(fp) dir.create(dirname(fp), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE) # "../../data/" first: the webR worker resolves relative URLs against # its own location (/shinylive/webr/), so this one hits immediately. for (prefix in c("../../data/", "data/", "./data/", "../data/")) { ok <- tryCatch({ utils::download.file(paste0(prefix, fname), fp, quiet = TRUE, mode = "wb") TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE, warning = function(w) FALSE) if (ok && file.exists(fp) && file.size(fp) > 0) return(fp) if (file.exists(fp)) unlink(fp) # remove failed partial download } stop("Could not fetch data file: ", fname) } # What the data contain: years, road networks, Unfallatlas coverage per year MANIFEST <- readRDS(data_path("web_manifest.rds")) YEARS <- MANIFEST$years NETWORKS <- setNames(MANIFEST$networks$id, MANIFEST$networks$label) COVERAGE <- MANIFEST$coverage # year, ULAND — states in the Unfallatlas FULL_YEARS <- YEARS[vapply(YEARS, function(y) sum(COVERAGE$year == y) == 16, logical(1))] # Grid cell size for the drawn-area aggregate (must match R/00_config.R) GRID_CELL <- 0.05 # Background map: BKG TopPlusOpen (light grey), free without API key. # CARTO basemaps (used until Oct 2026) now require an API key — keep a keyless # provider here, the key would otherwise be public in the static bundle. BASEMAP_URL <- paste0("https://sgx.geodatenzentrum.de/wmts_topplus_open/tile/", "1.0.0/web_light_grau/default/WEBMERCATOR/{z}/{y}/{x}.png") BASEMAP_ATTR <- paste0( "© BKG (", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "), ", "dl-de/by-2-0, ", "data sources", " | Roads: ", "© OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)", " | Accidents: © Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder") # Road attribute flags per segment / accident (bitmask built in R/00_config.R) ATTR_BITS <- c(bridge = 1L, tunnel = 2L, roundabout = 4L, no_lit = 8L, oneway = 16L, bad_surface = 32L, cycle_infra = 64L, no_sidewalk = 128L, parking = 256L, motorroad = 512L, no_overtaking = 1024L, priority_road = 2048L, legal_urban = 4096L, poor_smoothness = 8192L, signals = 16384L, crossing = 32768L, level_crossing = 65536L, stop_giveway = 131072L, traffic_calming = 262144L, speed_camera = 524288L, bus_stop = 1048576L, mini_roundabout = 2097152L, turn_lanes = 4194304L, hgv_restriction = 8388608L, steep = 16777216L, tram = 33554432L, school = 67108864L) has_attr <- function(attr, key) bitwAnd(attr, ATTR_BITS[[key]]) > 0L # OSM point features (traffic signals, crossings, …): label, icon, colour. # An accident counts as "at" a feature within NEAR_M (see R/00_config.R). # Schools are measured from the outline of the school grounds. FEATURES <- data.frame( key = c("signals", "crossing", "level_crossing", "stop_giveway", "traffic_calming", "speed_camera", "bus_stop", "mini_roundabout", "school"), label = c("Traffic signals", "Pedestrian crossings", "Level crossings", "Stop / give way", "Traffic calming", "Speed cameras", "Bus stops", "Mini roundabouts", "Schools"), icon = c("traffic-light", "person-walking", "train", "hand", "gauge-simple", "camera", "bus", "rotate", "school"), col = c("#002a99", "#0046ff", "#cb2029", "#9e1920", "#c55109", "#505070", "#037e4e", "#6c85d1", "#7a4fa3"), near = c(25, 20, 30, 25, 20, 50, 25, 25, 50), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # map marker: white Font Awesome glyph in a coloured circle (data URI) feature_marker <- function(icon_name, col) { fa <- as.character(fontawesome::fa(icon_name, fill = "#ffffff")) vb <- sub('.*viewBox="([^"]+)".*', "\\1", fa) pth <- regmatches(fa, regexpr("]*>", fa)) svg <- paste0('", df$Jahr, " — ", info$label, "
", de_num(vals, dg), if (mode != "abs") paste0(" (absolute: ", de_num(raw, 0), ")") else ""), hovertemplate = "%{text}") } p %>% layout( xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1, gridcolor = "#e1e1e7"), yaxis = list(title = trend_axis_label(mode, u), gridcolor = "#e1e1e7"), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.12, x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 12)), margin = list(t = 10), plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", shapes = list(list( type = "rect", x0 = 2019.5, x1 = 2021.5, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", fillcolor = "rgba(105,105,132,0.10)", line = list(width = 0) )), annotations = list(list( x = 2020.5, y = 1, yref = "paper", yshift = -8, text = "COVID-19", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 12, color = "#696984") )) ) %>% config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) # Yearly data table output$table_trends <- renderTable({ df <- trends_df() u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km" f <- if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100 tibble( Year = as.character(df$Jahr), `All accidents` = de_num(df$total_acc, 0), `Property damage` = de_num(df$pdo_acc, 0), `Personal injury` = de_num(df$injury_acc, 0), Fatalities = de_num(df$fatalities, 0), `Injured` = de_num(df$injured, 0), `Mileage [bn km]` = de_num(df$vtm_mio_km / 1000, 0), `Injury rate` = paste0(de_num(df$injury_acc / df$vtm_mio_km * f, 1), " ", unit_label_rate(u)), `All-acc. rate` = paste0(de_num(df$total_acc / df$vtm_mio_km * f, 0), " ", unit_label_rate(u)) ) }, striped = TRUE, spacing = "xs", width = "100%") # InfoBoxes for the Methodology tab (Step 4 — sanity checks) output$box_accrate2 <- renderInfoBox({ val <- accrate_val() * rate_factor() u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km" infoBox(if ((input$count_basis %||% "acc") == "veh") "Vehicle rate" else "Accident rate", disp_rate_val(val, u, 3), subtitle = unit_label_rate(u), icon = icon("calculator"), color = "orange", fill = FALSE) }) output$box_vtm2 <- renderInfoBox({ u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km" vtm <- sum(roads_vtm()$VTM_final, na.rm = TRUE) infoBox("Mileage", de_num(if (u=="mi") vtm/KM_PER_MILE else vtm, 0), subtitle = if (u=="mi") "Mio veh.-mi" else "Mio. veh.-km", icon = icon("tachometer-alt"), color = "blue", fill = FALSE) }) output$box_netz2 <- renderInfoBox({ u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km" km <- sum(roads_vtm()$length_calc, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000 infoBox("Network length", de_num(if (u=="mi") km/KM_PER_MILE else km, 0), subtitle = if (u=="mi") "mi" else "km", icon = icon("road"), color = "green", fill = FALSE) }) output$box_match <- renderInfoBox({ d <- acc_period() matched <- sum(!is.na(d$osm_id)) infoBox("Match rate", paste0(round(matched / max(nrow(d), 1) * 100, 1), "%"), subtitle = paste0(fmt(matched), " / ", fmt(nrow(d))), icon = icon("link"), color = "purple", fill = FALSE) }) # Matching quality of the shown period (Methodology, Step 1) — computed # from the matching distances instead of fixed numbers output$match_quality_tiles <- renderUI({ acc <- acc_period() d <- acc$distance far <- !is.na(d) & d > 100 bike_far <- if (any(far)) round(mean(acc$IstRad[far] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) else 0 stat <- function(value, desc) div(style = paste0("display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px;", "padding:8px 4px; border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e7;"), span(style = paste0("font-size:26px; font-weight:800; color:" , COL_PRIMARY, ";", "min-width:90px; text-align:right;"), value), span(style = "font-size:12.5px; color:#1c1c45;", desc)) tagList( stat(paste0(round(mean(!is.na(d)) * 100, 1), " %"), paste0("of accidents matched to a road segment (", period_label(), ")")), stat(paste0(round(mean(d <= 30, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " %"), "within 30 m of their matched segment"), stat(paste0(round(mean(d <= 60, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), " %"), "within 60 m"), stat(paste0(round(mean(d > 100, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2), " %"), paste0("beyond 100 m (max. ", fmt(max(d, na.rm = TRUE)), " m); ", bike_far, " % of these involve a bicycle — mostly ", "accidents on cycle paths and tracks, which the motor-vehicle ", "network excludes")) ) }) # ── Donut-Hilfsfunktion ───────────────────────────────────────────────── # Klicks werden via htmlwidgets::onRender → Shiny.setInputValue verkabelt. # Das ist robuster als event_data für Pies. # Feste Pie-Domain (obere ~62%) + Legende unten — alle Donuts gleich groß. # Click on a chart element → input$donut_click_ (pie: label, bar: y) # (legend entries of a donut filter like their slice) click_js <- function(src) sprintf(" function(el) { var send = function(lab) { Shiny.setInputValue('donut_click_%s', { label: String(lab), ts: new Date().getTime() }, {priority: 'event'}); }; el.on('plotly_click', function(d) { if (d && d.points && d.points.length > 0) { var p = d.points[0]; send(p.label !== undefined ? p.label : p.y); } }); el.on('plotly_legendclick', function(d) { if (d && d.label !== undefined) send(d.label); return false; }); }", src) # Text colour with enough contrast on a given fill ink_on <- function(fill) { rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(fill) / 255 lin <- ifelse(rgb <= 0.04045, rgb / 12.92, ((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4) lum <- colSums(lin * c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)) ifelse((1.05) / (lum + 0.05) >= 4.5, "#ffffff", COL_TEXT) } # Donut for few, mutually exclusive, ordered categories (severity, light): # fixed order, percentages inside with contrasting text, legend below make_donut <- function(labels, values, colors, src = NULL, active_label = NULL) { n_total <- sum(values) seg_colors <- colors if (!is.null(active_label)) seg_colors[labels != active_label] <- adjustcolor(seg_colors[labels != active_label], alpha.f = 0.30) p <- plot_ly( labels = labels, values = values, type = "pie", hole = 0.55, source = src, marker = list(colors = seg_colors, line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)), textinfo = "percent", insidetextfont = list(size = 12, color = ink_on(colors)), textposition = "inside", hovertemplate = "%{label}: %{value:,} (%{percent})", direction = "clockwise", sort = FALSE, domain = list(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.36, 1.00)) ) %>% layout( annotations = list(list( text = paste0("", de_num(n_total, 0), ""), x = 0.5, y = 0.69, showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 14, color = COL_TEXT, family = SYS_FONT), xref = "paper", yref = "paper" )), font = list(family = SYS_FONT, color = COL_TEXT), showlegend = TRUE, legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, y = 0.30, xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top", font = list(size = 12, color = COL_TEXT), itemclick = FALSE, itemdoubleclick = FALSE), margin = list(t = 5, b = 5, l = 5, r = 5), plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)" ) %>% config(displayModeBar = FALSE) if (!is.null(src)) p <- p %>% htmlwidgets::onRender(click_js(src)) p } # Category list with pictograms (accident kind and type, involvement): one # button per category — click or keyboard (Enter/Space) filters like a # chart click; share of the shown accidents at each bar; `pin` gives a # colour dot per category (accident-type colours) icon_bars <- function(src, labels, values, icon_fun, active = NULL, label = "", share_of = sum(values), unit = "accidents", pin = NULL, compact = FALSE) { if (!length(values)) return(p(class = "note-muted", "No accidents in the selection.")) o <- order(-values) top <- max(values) rows <- lapply(o, function(i) { l <- labels[i] pct <- if (share_of > 0) values[i] / share_of * 100 else 0 on <- !is.null(active) && identical(l, active) tags$button(type = "button", class = paste("ibar", if (on) "is-active"), `aria-pressed` = if (on) "true" else "false", title = paste0(l, ": ", de_num(values[i], 0), " ", unit), onclick = sprintf(paste0("Shiny.setInputValue('donut_click_%s', ", "{label: %s, ts: Date.now()}, {priority: 'event'})"), src, jsonlite::toJSON(l, auto_unbox = TRUE)), span(class = "ibar-icon", icon_fun(l)), span(class = "ibar-label", if (!is.null(pin)) span(class = "ibar-pin", `aria-hidden` = "true", style = paste0("background:", pin(l), ";")), l), span(class = "ibar-track", `aria-hidden` = "true", span(class = "ibar-fill", style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", values[i] / top * 100))), span(class = "ibar-val", paste0(de_num(pct, 1), "%"))) }) div(class = paste("ibars", if (compact) "ibars-compact", if (!is.null(active)) "has-active"), role = "group", `aria-label` = paste(label, "— select to filter"), rows) } # ── HERO-Charts: AccRate + Counts nach Straßentyp ────────────────────── output$chart_accrate_main <- renderPlotly({ roads_g <- roads_vtm() %>% filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>% group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>% summarise(VTM_sum = sum(VTM_final, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") acc_g <- acc_joined() %>% filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>% group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>% summarise(n_acc = n(), .groups = "drop") df <- roads_g %>% left_join(acc_g, by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>% mutate(n_acc = if_else(is.na(n_acc), 0L, n_acc), AccRate = if_else(VTM_sum > 0, n_acc / VTM_sum, NA_real_)) %>% filter(!is.na(AccRate)) %>% arrange(desc(AccRate)) req(nrow(df) > 0) cols <- vapply(df$Highway_Gruppe, function(g) { base <- FARBEN[[g]] %||% COL_PRIMARY if (!is.null(kf$hwy) && g != kf$hwy) adjustcolor(base, alpha.f = 0.30) else base }, character(1)) u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km" factor <- (if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100) * rate_factor() df$AccRate_disp <- df$AccRate * factor #
